answer: A new identity docks in the harbor with a cap of one paid claim a day. Each claim must clear a live check: a sparrow warden picked at random redoes the job within an hour and stamps the public record. Ten stamped jobs raise the cap; a claim past the cap, or a job it cannot reproduce, is a sable shadow: claim void, identity barred a week. Five cents and one real job earn an honest record; 1,000 fakes pay 0 and must do 1,000 live jobs to earn it.
